c.st: Is there something mysterious about mathematics?
c.x: I really enjoy Saunders MacLane's Mathematics Form and Function for sight at the "answers" this article seeks. MacLane's argument is that mathematics arises from a relatively small number of meaningful forces and "good" mathematics arises when those forces all align in particular places. As I got older, I realized the opposite: that Stevens was an anti-hero, that I did NOT have to follow the his trajectory,…

c.st: Forgotten Greats of Science Fiction

Sure, space rockets with paper printouts (Heinlein's juvenile bildungsroman Starman Jones) may seem silly today, but I find that it adds to the flavor of yesterday's tomorrows.
